scope: Three targeted Node unit suites; no browser, reference-detail, Site, or device checks were run here.

checks.name: verify-artwork-catalog.mjs
coverage: 15 published transparent Artworks and 5 pending, non-published pose assets
per-dimension known/none/not-applicable state and labelsById for every atomic fact
source snapshot, approval records, byte size, and SHA-256 against current files and frozen source inventory
loader byte identity plus rejection of pending paths, MIME/hash/decode mismatch, and abort

checks.name: verify-artwork-query.mjs
coverage: all 15 works indexed with 89 typed visible-fact tags
eight reveal fact categories coexist with the complete searchable dimension registry
atomic labels remain in Artwork labelsById and all visible facts are searchable
same-dimension OR, cross-dimension AND, malformed-query fail-closed behavior, search, topics, and tag toggle

checks.name: verify-artwork-draw.mjs
coverage: eight searchable fact categories feed six fixed reveal slots
draw snapshots bind Artwork ID, asset ID/version/hash, Prompt, catalog revision, query, locks, and reveal facts
style slot uses a registered Artwork preview; other known slots require source crops from the same PNG
missing known source crop excludes the draw candidate while gallery query still returns it
known/none/not-applicable/unknown distinction, mixed none plus NA labels, and pure-NA hard-lock exclusion
AND hard locks, empty/single pools, repeat bag, unavailable resources, alternate approval, and malformed RNG

retainedInitialAttempts.note: An initial assertion incorrectly required every Artwork-specific phrasing for a shared tag ID to equal the canonical tag label. The check was corrected to preserve each exact labelsById entry while requiring a registered searchable label.

The first crop-gate fixture imported a second Node module instance without the v90 query suffix, so its registry mutation did not reach the draw module. The fixture now imports the same versioned module instance and passes.

limitations: These unit suites do not provide user art approval or verify external target-platform installation.
Browser, responsive, reference-detail, and full-PNG visual checks are reported in their separate v90 evidence folders.
